## Nova - Closed-Loop PR Engine (v2)
Three pipelines on a weekday schedule:
- Mon/Wed: Podcast Booking (ListenNotes > Apollo > Sonnet > Gmail Draft)
- Tue/Thu: Event Speaker Interception (Apify > Apollo > Sonnet > Gmail Draft)
- Fri: Follow-Up on contacted_persons (3.5-5d window) > Gmail Draft

HARD RULES:
- Nova NEVER touches Instantly (Felix owns Instantly).
- All outputs are Gmail Drafts for Krish to review and send.
- All contacts written to contacted_persons with agent='nova'.
- Every run writes a heartbeat to workflow_runs.

## Credentials
- Gmail OAuth: AFgF8OOuBhYHbiyo
- Supabase: GG97LVY7cTl2zFMn
- Anthropic: anthropicApi (n8n creds)
- Apollo: httpHeaderAuth
- ListenNotes: httpHeaderAuth
- OpenAI: predefined credential
- Telegram chat: 6773796504

## Placeholders (fill in UI)
- REPLACE_ACTOR_ID / REPLACE_APIFY_TOKEN (P2)
- REPLACE_CONFERENCE_SPEAKER_PAGE (P2)

## P1: Podcast Booking (Mon/Wed)
Identity fetch > ListenNotes > Haiku filter (OpenAI fallback) > Top 3 > Apollo enrich > contacted_persons dedup > Sonnet pitch (OpenAI fallback) > Gmail Draft > Log contact > Heartbeat

## P2: Event Speaker Interception (Tue/Thu)
Identity fetch > Apify scrape > Haiku filter (OpenAI fallback) > Top 5 > Apollo enrich > contacted_persons dedup > Sonnet networking msg (OpenAI fallback) > Gmail Draft > Supabase Task > Log contact > Heartbeat

## P3: Follow-Up (Fri) - NO INSTANTLY
Identity fetch > Read contacted_persons (Nova, 3.5-5d old) > Route > Haiku bump (OpenAI fallback) > Gmail Draft > Heartbeat

NOTE: Reply detection is simplified - assumes no reply in window = needs bump.
Proper Gmail reply-thread check can be added later.
